_note: Synthetic support tickets for the fictional company Halden Industrial. Each field carries a label set where the data lives (the source), not by the agent that reads it. People appear by employee number only; numbers, phone and addresses are invented.

summary.value: VPN connection fails from home after a password change.

resolution.value: Sign out of the VPN client, sign in again with the new password, then restart the client.
